test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by conclusions. Assuming the statements to be true ,even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow ( s ) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some elephants are chairs.

All elephants are doors.

**Conclusions:**

1. At least some chairs are doors.

2. All doors are elephants.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d11df23352ba3143c2ed27d2e485961fe640a3a6e83bd27aae3bf8f621a6079e.png] 

Conclusions:

1. At least some chairs are doors → Follow (As some elephants are chairs and all elephants are doors. As some part of chairs is common with elephants which whole comes in doors, therefore it is true)

2. All doors are elephants → Does not follow (As all elephants are doors. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Only conclusion 1 follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
